source: edwin-sonorisation (note 90 ; salle de nuit, tables de fête sans personne, ambiances, sections notées 4-5), will-midoux (cabane, feu de camp, soirées en silhouettes, sections notées 4-5), les-plus-hautes-eaux (projecteur sur l'eau, théâtre inondé, notées 4-5), bendandpeel, loeilsingulier (quatuor : silhouette en trop), petitenature, fanfare-dongelberg ; règle de la skill « corps en silhouette, flou de bougé ou contre-jour ».
style: Cinematic night-event photography, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, light atmospheric haze, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, premium editorial look, photorealistic, high detail.
interdits: No visible face, no brand names on any equipment, no setlist, no poster, no ticket, no real venue, no strobe pattern, no nudity.
evite: Évite le visage et la silhouette en trop (quatuor de loeilsingulier) : public de dos, musiciens en contre-jour bien séparés, et jamais une salle présentée comme le vrai lieu de la tournée.

404.consigne: An empty stage after the show, a single microphone stand left alone in a pool of fading amber light, cables on the floor, haze, nobody.

ouverture.consigne: Wide shot of {sujet} at night seen from just behind the stage: light beams fanning out through haze above a crowd shown only as dark backlit silhouettes with raised hands in the bottom third.

section-fond.consigne: A calm, dark body of water at night seen from just above the surface, a single warm stage spotlight falling from above and reflecting as a long rippling streak of light, gentle haze.

scene-metier.consigne: Late afternoon sunlight through a window onto an empty small stage, {sujet}, cables coiled on the wooden floor, all with no visible brands, quiet soundcheck mood, nobody in the frame.

lieu.consigne: Surreal and poetic scene: a small, empty, old-fashioned theatre with worn wooden stage boards and rows of velvet seats, calm dark water flooding the room, mirror-like reflections, one warm spotlight on the empty stage, an atmospheric mood image, not a portrait of a real venue.
lieu.evite: Le vrai lieu présenté comme tel.

texture.consigne: Out-of-focus warm fairy lights and small bulbs reflected in a wet dark surface at night, large soft bokeh discs, nothing in focus.

portrait-generique.consigne: A performer in silhouette mid-performance seen from the side of the stage, strong warm backlight, haze, slight motion blur, face in deep shadow, only one figure in the frame.
portrait-generique.source: will-midoux grok-soiree-3-concert (notée 4-5), consigne corrigée du quatuor (« each musician clearly separated »)
portrait-generique.evite: Le membre en trop et le visage éclairé.
